note: The main banks: Grønlandsbanken and Bankivik, Greenland's two banks. Grønlandsbanken's site (banken.gl) answers 403 to every request through its gateway's firewall (30 October 2026), so its cards aren't written. Bankivik's price book (in force from 25 September 2026) and its interest overview (in force from 1 May 2026), read in full: its four personal Mastercard credit cards, the Standard without insurance, Standard, Gold and Platinum, each with its yearly card fee from the price book (150, 250, 1,000 and 1,800 kroner; the older interest overview gives 900 and 1,600 for the Gold and Platinum, superseded). The interest overview gives each a nominal rate 'from 0.00% to 14.50%', and its note 12 says the lowest applies when the whole balance is paid when billed and the highest when it isn't: so the rate on what's carried is 14.50% a year, written so, and the bill comes 15 to 42 days after a purchase, written as 42 days' grace. Cash withdrawals cost 2% (at least 50 kroner) at home and abroad; payments in shops cost nothing; spending in another currency is converted at the Nets rate plus 1.5% for European currencies and 2.0% for others (written as 2.0); a payment returned for want of funds costs 200 kroner. The family and business cards and the fees for urgent orders, couriers, copies, unjustified disputes, blocking for misuse and limit changes, met only on request or misuse, aren't written; no minimum payment, late fee or over-limit fee is stated. This file kept the MC Standard without insurance, read on 29 October 2026, and adds the rest. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no bank was added. Greenland has only these two banks, and Grønlandsbanken's firewall answered 403 on the earlier reading, so it wasn't retried.
